lines.zh: 我头顶的喇叭，先替你报时。
lines.en: The horns on my head announce the hour.

lines.zh: 电线杆一样高，走路很慢。
lines.en: Tall as a telegraph pole, I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脚步，你听着像地震。
lines.en: My steps sound like an earthquake to you.

lines.zh: 我穿过雾，雾缠在我身上。
lines.en: I walk through fog, and it clings to me.

lines.zh: 我的头比我的身体还显眼。
lines.en: My head stands out more than my body.

lines.zh: 我踩断树，声音在很远都听得见。
lines.en: I snap trees, and the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我沿着公路走，电线在头顶。
lines.en: I walk the highway with wires overhead.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪动，像一座走的塔。
lines.en: I move slowly, like a walking tower.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊太细，垂到膝盖。
lines.en: My arms are too thin and hang past my knees.

lines.zh: 雾里看不清我，只听见脚步。
lines.en: In the fog you can't see me, only hear the steps.
I cross the ridge.

lines.zh: 我每一步，都让鸟群惊飞。
lines.en: Birds burst up with every step.
I stand quieter than the trees.
Something turns inside my head, sounding.
Fog curls around my feet.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，听着几里外的风。
lines.en: I stand still, listening miles away.
There's a car far off. I hear it.
My head turns half a circle, slowly.

lines.zh: 两条手臂垂着，一动不动。
lines.en: Both arms hang still.

lines.zh: 树林里的鸟，全都不叫了。
lines.en: Every bird in the wood has gone quiet.
I lift a foot, then set it down.
The fog thickens. Good.
Someone's running. Their steps are quick.
No hurry. He won't get far.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的声音，先低后高。
lines.en: I hear my own voice, rising.
The sound in my head pauses.
You looked up. Then it's late.

lines.zh: 我的头，和你的整个人一样大。
lines.en: My head is as big as all of you.

lines.zh: 你能看清我嘴在哪里吗？
lines.en: Can you tell where my mouth is?
I bend down to look at you.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，别举那个东西。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking. Don't raise that.
This face of mine is two horns.

lines.zh: 雾里我的轮廓，越来越清楚。
lines.en: In the fog my outline sharpens.

lines.zh: 你听见了，对吧，那个声音。
lines.en: You hear it, don't you. That sound.
Don't cover your ears. It won't help.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我从很远就听见了。
lines.en: I heard your name from very far away.
I lower my head, so you run.
There were people here before.
They're all quiet now.

lines.zh: 我不吃你，我只想让你听。
lines.en: I don't eat you. I only want you to listen.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，是两个喇叭口。
lines.en: I open my mouth. Two horn mouths.

lines.zh: 你捂着耳朵跑，跑得挺好。
lines.en: You run with your ears covered. Good running.
I still keep up.
You shouldn't have looked up at me.
Look up now and it's already late.

lines.zh: 喇叭转向你，只对你说话。
lines.en: My speaker turns and speaks only to you.
That one pushed me back a step.
A tree fell and I stumbled.
I lower my head toward the sound.
Pain. I don't feel it often.
You cut that stretch of the melody.
I raise a hand and feel something wet.
I straighten up, taller than before.

lines.zh: 警报响了一声，算记住了你。
lines.en: My siren sounds once; I have noted you.

lines.zh: 我要把头低到你的高度。
lines.en: I'll bring my head down to your height.
Then I sound the second note.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，是想给我？
lines.en: You're holding that up. For me?

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想听你说话。
lines.en: I don't eat. I only want to hear you speak.

lines.zh: 你说一句，我就靠近一步。
lines.en: Say one word and I come one step closer.

lines.zh: 把那个放下，声音会清楚些。
lines.en: Put that down and the sound will be clearer.
Your voice is higher than the others'.
I lower my head, slowly.
Don't stop. Keep talking.
I raise a hand and you step back.
A voice this good should be kept.
Shout once more for me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，像撞一根柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a pillar.
I look down; fog between us.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀撞疼了。
lines.en: That must have hurt your shoulder.
I take half a step and a tree goes down.
My arm brushes past your head.

lines.zh: 你从我腿间钻过去，跑了。
lines.en: You duck between my legs and run.
I don't chase. I don't need to.
We left two deep footprints.

lines.zh: 雾把我罩住了，你丢了方向。
lines.en: Fog covers me and you lose your bearings.
In the fog this suits me better.
There's only one of me here.
I've heard that sound twice.
The first time, in a distant valley.
We answered each other through the fog.
Afterward the valley was empty.
I don't know where it went.

lines.zh: 我头里的声音，和它一样。
lines.en: The sound in my head is the same as hers.
So I need nothing else.
The fog will take everything.
The fog takes everything, me included.

lines.zh: 我用两根长指把它捏起来。
lines.en: I pinch it up between two long fingers.

lines.zh: 在我手里，它小得看不见。
lines.en: In my hand it's almost invisible.
I hold it up to the horn and listen.
It made a small sound.
I'll keep that sound.

lines.zh: 这东西在我掌里轻得像纸。
lines.en: It weighs like paper in my palm.
I lifted it too high and it fell.
It hit the ground with a nice sound.

lines.zh: 我趴下去，耳朵贴着地面。
lines.en: I lie down with my ear to the ground.
There's still an echo on the ground.
A light over there, moving.
I heard it. Footsteps.
One. Not two.
I turn my head and the fog turns with it.
It's running into the trees.
There's no path in there.
One step gets me there.
The sound is getting clearer.
I lower my head to treetop height.
Now the game begins.

lines.zh: 你听见的第一个音，是我。
lines.en: The first note you hear is mine.

lines.zh: 第二个音，你就站不住了。
lines.en: By the second, you won't be standing.
I don't run. Walking is enough.
This wood is only so big.
The end is that way.
I'll wait at the end.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的长腿跟一步。
lines.en: Every step you take, my long legs take one.
You hide behind a tree. I count to three.
First step. I'm counting.
Second step. The fog thickens.
On the third, I lower my head.
I raise my head and the fog thins a little.
If you can see me, don't move.

lines.zh: 我的声音在树之间反弹。
lines.en: My voice bounces between the trees.
You can't tell where it's coming from.
I sound from three directions at once.

lines.zh: 你的手从耳朵上放下来了。
lines.en: Your hands have come off your ears.
You've started listening.
That note carried a long way.
Listen a little longer.
I'm closer. You haven't noticed.

lines.zh: 我的头是警笛，先响再走。
lines.en: My head is a siren. It sounds before I move.
Now. Don't turn around.
Your head has turned.

lines.zh: 电流窜上来，喇叭开始嘶鸣。
lines.en: The current rises and my siren begins to wail.
I lower my head beneath the treetops.
I bring a foot down and the ground gives.
I snatch with a hand and catch nothing.

lines.zh: 我的手臂砸下来，树断了。
lines.en: My arm comes down and a tree breaks.
After that you can't get up.
I lift you up to look.
You're very small in my hand.
I open both horns at you.
The sound comes from very close.
You're shaking in my hand.
I set you down and you run again.
That's fine. It saves a chase.
I follow along behind.
The fog has thickened another layer.
I lift a foot and leave a hollow.
You're running the wrong way.
There's no way out that side.

lines.zh: 雾里先出现的，是我的头。
lines.en: In the fog my head appears first.
Taller than the trees, I stand in the wood.

lines.zh: 电线在我头边，像另一根。
lines.en: The wires beside my head look like one more.
My first sound is a long one.
Every bird in the wood takes flight at once.
I look up and see cloud.
My feet are on grass and the grass makes no sound.
I hear a village in the distance.
Where there are people, there are sounds.
I turn my head toward the village.
The fog covers for me.
First I need the tallest tree.
You can see far from there.
My head has started to sound.
Very low, very slow.
Then high.

lines.zh: 你听见的时候，我已经在附近。
lines.en: By the time you hear it, I'm already near.
My advice: don't look up.
Look up and you'll see me.
See me, and it's over.
Fire burns on me, very bright.

lines.zh: 我从高处倒下来，压断一片树。
lines.en: I fall from height and crush a stand of trees.

lines.zh: 水到我的膝盖，我却上不来。
lines.en: Water at my knees, and I can't rise.
The blast knocks my head askew.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的手臂，很轻。
lines.en: Something sticks in my arm. Very light.

lines.zh: 一道光绕着我的头，声音乱了。
lines.en: Light circles my head and the sound tangles.

lines.zh: 没有声音可听，我很难受。
lines.en: There are no sounds to hear. It hurts.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的头上，响得比我大。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my head, louder than I am.
I fall, and the fog falls with me.
